reading.title: Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare
reading.passage: Artificial intelligence is revolutionizing the healthcare industry by improving diagnostic accuracy and patient outcomes. AI algorithms can analyze medical images and detect diseases like cancer earlier than human radiologists. Machine learning models trained on vast datasets enable physicians to predict patient deterioration and intervene proactively. Furthermore, AI-powered chatbots provide patients with preliminary medical advice, reducing unnecessary hospital visits. However, concerns about data privacy and the need for regulatory frameworks remain significant challenges that must be addressed before widespread implementation.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one advantage of using AI algorithms in healthcare?
options: They eliminate the need for human doctors
They can detect diseases like cancer earlier than human radiologists
They guarantee perfect medical diagnoses
They reduce healthcare costs by 100%
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'AI algorithms can analyze medical images and detect diseases like cancer earlier than human radiologists'라고 명시되어 있습니다. 다른 선택지들은 본문의 내용을 과장하거나 왜곡한 것입니다.

questions.q: What does the passage suggest about the challenges of implementing AI in healthcare?
options: There are no challenges to implementation
Data privacy and regulatory frameworks are significant concerns
AI is ready for immediate implementation everywhere
Patients refuse to use AI-powered systems
questions.explanation: 'However, concerns about data privacy and the need for regulatory frameworks remain significant challenges that must be addressed'라는 문장에서 직접적으로 설명하고 있습니다.

questions.q: How do AI-powered chatbots benefit patients according to the passage?
options: They provide preliminary medical advice and reduce unnecessary hospital visits
They replace human doctors completely
They diagnose all diseases with 100% accuracy
They are free for all patients
questions.explanation: 'AI-powered chatbots provide patients with preliminary medical advice, reducing unnecessary hospital visits'라는 문장에서 명확하게 설명되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Remote work is more productive than working in an office environment'? Provide specific reasons and examples to support your position.

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 표시 (동의 또는 반대)와 2-3개의 주요 이유를 미리 제시하기. 예: 'I strongly agree/disagree that remote work is more productive because...'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유 전개: 직장 환경에서의 방해 요소 감소, 출퇴근 시간 절약으로 인한 생산성 증가 또는 대면 협업의 중요성 설명
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유 전개: 업무 유형에 따른 차이 (창의적 업무 vs 협업 업무), 기술 발전으로 원격 협업 가능성 또는 팀 문화 구축의 어려움
structure.conclusion: 입장 재확인 및 결론. 양쪽 관점을 인정하되 자신의 입장이 더 타당함을 강조

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer studying alone, while others prefer studying in groups. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer studying alone because...
One reason is that studying alone allows me to...
Another advantage is that I can focus better when...
I think this is important because...
For example, when I study with others...
sample_points: 혼자 공부할 때의 장점: 집중력 향상, 자신의 속도로 학습 진행 가능, 방해 요소 최소화, 복잡한 개념을 충분한 시간을 들여 이해할 수 있음
그룹 스터디의 장점 (반대 입장): 다양한 관점 공유, 동료에게서 배우기, 동기 부여 증대, 토론을 통한 이해 심화, 질문 기회 증가

listening.title: Academic Advising Session
listening.script: Advisor: Good morning! I see you're interested in changing your major from engineering to environmental science. Can you tell me what sparked this interest? Student: Well, I've been taking some elective courses in environmental studies, and I really enjoyed learning about climate change and sustainability. I feel like engineering isn't quite the right path for me. Advisor: That's very common. Many students discover their true passion through electives. Now, changing majors will affect your graduation timeline. You'll need to complete additional coursework in biology, chemistry, and environmental policy. This might delay your graduation by a semester or two. Student: I understand. How many credits do I need? Advisor: For environmental science, you need 120 credits total, with 45 specifically in environmental courses. You've already completed about 60 credits in general education and engineering, which can count as electives. So you're looking at approximately 60 more credits. We should also discuss scholarships, as some of them are major-specific. Student: Will I lose my current engineering scholarship? Advisor: Possibly. Let me check our database. Many scholarships are flexible, but some are restricted to specific majors. I'll help you explore alternative funding options.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: To discuss the student's scholarship options
To discuss the student's major change from engineering to environmental science
To explain the engineering program requirements
To register the student for next semester's courses
questions.explanation: 대화의 전체 내용이 학생의 전공 변경(engineering에서 environmental science로)에 관한 것입니다. Advisor는 이에 따른 학점 요구사항, 졸업 시간, 장학금 영향 등을 설명하고 있습니다.

questions.q: According to the advisor, how many additional credits does the student need to complete for the new major?
options: 120 credits
60 credits
45 credits
90 credits
questions.explanation: Advisor가 'For environmental science, you need 120 credits total... You've already completed about 60 credits... So you're looking at approximately 60 more credits'라고 명시했습니다.

questions.q: What concern does the student raise at the end of the conversation?
options: The student is worried about finding housing
The student is concerned about losing the current engineering scholarship
The student wants to know about campus facilities
The student asks about internship opportunities
questions.explanation: 학생이 'Will I lose my current engineering scholarship?'라고 직접 묻고 있으며, Advisor가 일부 장학금은 제한될 수 있음을 설명합니다.
